maddeler.e:
يبتكرون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَكِرُونَ (yabtakirūna) /jab.ta.ki.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# يُبْتَكَرُونَ (yubtakarūna) /jub.ta.ka.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
